topic.title: Turtle Hello World
topic.description: First steps with the Turtle graphics module: importing, creating a Turtle object, and calling movement methods. A graphical equivalent of Hello World.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Importing turtle, creating a Turtle instance, and using forward(), left(), and right() to move and turn.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding the object-oriented interface for the first time.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Draw geometric shapes and experiment with color and speed.

files.description: Turtle intro: creates turtle and moves forward.
